title: HAMSTER: CLAW progress update: maps, VFX, interactions, and optimization
author: Tap_Little
selftext:
I’ve been making steady updates to HAMSTER: CLAW, my hamster ARPG where you combine different weapons, items, and skills.



Since the earlier footage, I’ve reworked the maps, improved the VFX, refined some interactions, and worked on performance. This trailer shows the latest version. I’m continuing to polish it, aiming for a demo in December.



For development, I’ve mainly used Claude Opus 5.5 with Blender for maps and some objects, Astra for textures and concept images, and Meshy AI for 3D models.



Wishlist on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363820/HAMSTER\_CLAW/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363820/HAMSTER_CLAW/)
